imgDesc.text: This appears to be a leftover from an earlier time when someone was studying the Shadow Realm. Using part of the Shadow Realm as a barrier, it holds a good number of firearms and firearm parts inside. Upgrade the mysterious access card in your possession, and you might just be able to shut down the barrier and open the Shadow Realm Vault.
